items.question: Why does the washer stop before spin?
items.answer: Usually because water has not drained, the load is unbalanced, or a pump/sensor fault stops the program. Common service areas include the city center, Khimshiashvili, New Boulevard, Boni, Airport area and Gonio.

items.question: Can I clean the filter myself?
items.answer: Yes, if water is drained and the filter opens normally. Stop if it is stuck or leaking.
